package.description: Speed up your tool-use by mapping shortcuts, commands and more to a visual grid.

en-US.description: Speed up your tool-use by mapping shortcuts, commands and more to a visual grid.
en-US.longDescription: FastAction is a PowerToys-inspired Windows keyboard overlay. Press a global hotkey to open a QWERTY-aligned action grid. Keys and clicks run shell commands or open nested grids.
en-US.name: FastAction
